title: Activation-on-Orders Credits Standing in the TRICARE Reserve Select Reserve Select Closing Reconciliation
content:
**Training questions - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select.**

**Rule.** Activation-on-orders credits already standing against a bill taken in are taken off what that bill brings into the Reserve Select closing reconciliation: where they cover only part of the days that bill covers, they are spread over the days they cover and taken off for the counted days from the first day they cover; where they cover every day that bill covers, they are spread over those days and taken off for every counted day; otherwise nothing is taken off.

**Which credits?** The credits with reason activation on orders already posted against the bill taken in, in total, with the coverage days they show.

**Which days do they cover?** Credits covering part of a bill's days cover the last of those days, through the last day of the month.

**What does "spread over" mean?** The credits divided by the number of days, giving a daily figure taken off once for each counted day reached.

## Cases (hypothetical: June monthly bill covering 30 days, counted days 15 to 30 June)

| Activation-on-orders credits on the bill | Days they cover | Taken off |
|---|---|---|
| 40.78 | 20, 11 to 30 June | 40.78 divided by 20 for the 16 counted days: 32.624 |
| 61.17 | 30, the whole month | 61.17 divided by 30 for the 16 counted days: 32.624 |
| none | - | nothing |
